texts.zh:
[leader.GetName]发现了[from.GetName]上剧烈喷发的源头。

这颗气态巨行星的大气的气态中间层和平流层之间悬浮着一层液态金属氢化物。下层密度更高的甲烷气体托举着这些液体漂浮。

随着时间的推移，释放的电荷在金属氢内部积聚，扰动亚层。在压力达到临界点后，气体向上层大气中喷出高导电性液体，弥散到整颗行星之后重新沉降下来。

我们的追踪系统可以轻易显示这些压力波动，方便我们收获这些高价值资源。
texts.en:
[leader.GetName] has uncovered the source of the volatile eruptions on [from.GetName].

The atmosphere of this gas giant has formed in such a way that a layer of liquid metallic hydrogen is suspended between the gaseous mesosphere and stratosphere. The denser composition of methane gas in the lower layer keeps the fluid aloft.

Over time, electrical discharges build up within the metallic hydrogen, agitating the sublayer. After a critical build up of pressure, gaseous eruptions spew out highly conductive liquid into the upper atmosphere, dissipating across the planet before resettling.

Our tracking systems can easily monitor these pressure fluctuations, allowing us to harvest these valuable resources.

summary.text:
# 喷发巨行星 / Erupting Giant

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc）

## 如何开始 How it starts

气态巨行星可能生成（6级，权重3，全局一次 max_once；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a gas giant (level 6, weight 3, once per game via max_once; needs has_shroud_dlc).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.300“分层大气”：星球获得 d_exotic_gases_2、d_alloys_2 与 d_energy_2 矿藏，并在1天后触发通用事件 action.941。

Single result extreme_frontiers.300 "Layered Atmosphere": the planet gains d_exotic_gases_2, d_alloys_2 and d_energy_2 deposits and the generic event action.941 fires 1 day later.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支，无后续章节。

Single outcome; no random branch and no further chapter.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异。

No empire differences.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:496; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1443 (extreme_frontiers.300)
